scope: Registration -> invitation/acceptance -> worker-reported check -> first room response -> reconnect/revocation; no feature expansion

defect.trigger: A selected room projects connection or runtime_check as null while the global agent registry has evidence from another scope
defect.before: journeyStatus and renderJourney used || to substitute global evidence; even a prior response count could incorrectly yield participating
defect.after: Selected membership projection, including null, is authoritative for status, last contact and error display; global evidence is used only without a selected membership
defect.server_contract: No API/worker/ACL change. New API test proves the server already withholds another room check or connection and rejects readiness.

before_fix_regressions.note: Initial negative cases used prior reported response count 1; final cases additionally cover actual fresh-check count 0
